title: Diagnosing Low-Confidence Patient Profiles via Localized Harmful Covariate Shift Detection
abstract: arXiv:2610.19178v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Before deploying clinical prediction models, their reliability must be assessed to ensure safe use. Errors may arise from distribution shifts between training and deployment or from heterogeneous performance where the model systematically underperforms for certain patient subgroups. Yet most post-hoc diagnostic methods evaluate reliability only at the population level, checking whether the deployment data resemble the training data and whether the model performs well on average, without accounting for heterogeneity that may cause some patients to be disproportionately affected. We propose a unified diagnostic pipeline that combines both perspectives. MED3pa first discovers interpretable low-confidence patient profiles, and Detectron is then applied within each profile to test whether its degradation is associated with a detectable harmful covariate shift. translated_title: 通过局部有害协变量偏移检测诊断低置信度患者画像
translated_abstract: 在部署临床预测模型之前，必须评估其可靠性以确保安全使用。错误可能源于训练与部署之间的分布偏移，也可能来自异质性能，即模型在某些患者亚群中系统性地表现不佳。然而，大多数事后诊断方法仅在总体层面评估可靠性，只检查部署数据是否类似于训练数据、模型平均表现是否良好，而未考虑可能导致某些患者受到不成比例影响的异质性。我们提出了一个统一这两种视角的诊断流程：MED3pa首先发现可解释的低置信度患者画像，随后在每个画像内部应用Detectron，以检验其性能退化是否与可检测的有害协变量偏移相关。在MIMIC-数据集上的三项临床预测任务和三种注入的亚群偏移中……（原文摘要至此被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出结合MED3pa与Detectron的统一诊断流程，先识别可解释的低置信度患者画像，再在各画像内检测有害协变量偏移，从而定位临床预测模型在特定患者亚群中的性能退化。
